_about: THE UNMASKED VOICE (2026-10-01): audition lines for the moment the dealer's mask comes off in the fight. German and his mannerisms in full. Generated against a separate saved voice (never the shipping dealer): generate.py --lines this --voice <id> --out tmp/black_market_vo/unmasked/<name>. Nothing here ships yet; no alias rows, no hooks.

lines.text: [laughs maniacally] Surprised? [pause] Oooh, you should see your faces! [giggles]
Did you really think a MASK could hide me? [laughs] Wunderbar!
Ja, ja, ja... the Doctor is IN. [giggles] And the Doctor is very, very disappointed in you.
The voices told me you would come. [pause] They never lie. [pause][sinister] Unlike me.
My children! [excited] Come! Come to Papa! [laughs maniacally]
One. One. Five. [pause] The whole tower runs on it. [giggles] So do I.
You want to know what I did with the little girl? [pause][giggles] So does she.
[angry] NEIN! [pause][calm] ...No. No, that is quite enough. [giggles] Let us begin.
